assessment.nobel_worthiness: GLP-1 physiology led to incretin-based drugs that transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity; the combination of basic hormone biology and large clinical benefit is exceptional and still growing.
assessment.attribution: Holst (physiology and secretion of GLP-1), Drucker (actions and biology, GLP-2) and Mojsov (identification of the active GLP-1(7-36) peptide) are the strongest fit among the supplied names; Knudsen's drug-development role is real but more industrial, and priority credit for the peptide remains contested.
assessment.maturity: Efficacy has been confirmed by many independent large randomized trials and approvals; recognition is timely and arguably pressing.
uncertainties: Allocation of credit for the active peptide and for early therapeutic concepts is disputed.
Other contributors outside the supplied names, as I recall them, may have comparable claims; I have not verified this.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Engineered T cells with chimeric receptors produce durable remissions in refractory B-cell malignancies; this is a new therapeutic modality grounded in clear molecular design.
assessment.attribution: June and Sadelain led the decisive CAR designs with costimulatory domains and clinical translation; Rosenberg pioneered adoptive cell therapy and gene-modified T cells in patients. A fair trio is plausible, but the conceptual precursors (for example Eshhar's early chimeric receptors) are not among the supplied names.
assessment.maturity: Multiple approved products and a decade of follow-up confirm benefit in leukemia and lymphoma; limitations in solid tumors and toxicity are acknowledged but do not undercut the core discovery.
uncertainties: Credit for the original chimeric receptor concept falls outside the supplied names.
Long-term durability and safety, including secondary malignancies, are still maturing.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: The unfolded protein response is a conceptually clean, original discovery of a new intracellular signaling pathway from the ER to the nucleus, with broad relevance to proteostasis, secretory disease and cancer.
assessment.attribution: Walter and Mori independently and complementarily defined the Ire1/Hac1 (XBP1) mechanism and the pathway logic; two laureates is a clear and fair configuration.
assessment.maturity: Mechanism has been confirmed over decades in yeast and mammals and is textbook knowledge; recognition is mature, with disease relevance continuing to develop.
uncertainties: Contributions from other groups on PERK and ATF6 arms (for example Ron, Mori) may be debated; I have not verified detailed priority.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: TOR defines a central growth and nutrient-sensing kinase pathway with sweeping consequences for metabolism, ageing, immunity and cancer; the discovery was original and has proven unusually durable.
assessment.attribution: Hall identified TOR genetically in yeast and established its role in growth control; Schreiber's work on rapamycin and FKBP12 and the target link is key chemical-biology context. Sabatini's mammalian mTOR work is substantial but I leave him out to keep a tight, less contested trio.
assessment.maturity: Strongly confirmed across organisms with clinical use of rapalogs; recognition is timely and mature.
uncertainties: The relative weight of the chemical-genetic (Schreiber) versus yeast-genetic (Hall) steps, and of mammalian follow-up, is unresolved.
Sabatini's inclusion is uncertain; I do not independently verify any controversies.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Optogenetics gave neuroscience and physiology a general tool for causal manipulation of defined cells and is a methodological invention with very large impact.
assessment.attribution: Nagel and Hegemann identified and characterized channelrhodopsin function, and Deisseroth made the tool work broadly in neurons and behavior; Bamberg, Boyden and Miesenboeck all have strong claims, so a three-person cap forces difficult omissions.
assessment.maturity: Widely adopted for over a decade; early clinical applications (vision restoration) are beginning but not yet decisive.
uncertainties: Attribution is the central problem: more than three people have credible claims.
Therapeutic maturity is limited, and this is a tool rather than a disease-oriented discovery.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: VLP-based HPV vaccines are a clear case of discovery-to-prevention, with large reductions in infection, precancer and cervical cancer in vaccinated cohorts.
assessment.attribution: Lowy and Schiller developed L1 VLPs; Frazer's group contributed independently to the VLP vaccine concept (with Zhou). Credit among them is plausible though not fully settled, and the cancer-virus link was already recognized in 2008.
assessment.maturity: Population-level effectiveness data are now strong and independent; timing is good.
uncertainties: Overlap with the prior HPV recognition and the exact contribution of Zhou, who is not listed, complicate credit.
Long-term cancer outcomes are still accumulating in some populations.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: LTP is the foundational cellular model of synaptic plasticity and memory, with decisive conceptual influence on neuroscience.
assessment.attribution: Bliss and Lømo made the original observation; Collingridge identified NMDA receptor dependence, a mechanistic core. Morris's behavioral link is important but a three-person cap forces a choice.
assessment.maturity: Observation dates from 1973 and mechanism has been replicated extensively, so maturity is high; any delay is not a weakness.
uncertainties: The causal link from LTP to memory in vivo remains debated.
Several other mechanistic contributors exist; attribution is crowded.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Demonstrating TNF as a therapeutic target in rheumatoid arthritis changed treatment of inflammatory disease and validated cytokine blockade as a strategy.
assessment.attribution: Feldmann and Maini's clinical-translational work is clearly central and a two-person prize is coherent; contributions from antibody engineers and cytokine discoverers outside the supplied names would complicate this.
assessment.maturity: Very mature, with decades of clinical use and confirmed benefit across several diseases.
uncertainties: Whether the committee views this as a discovery of sufficient basic originality versus translational advance is uncertain.
Credit among cytokine biology, antibody development and clinical proof is shared widely.
